notes_for_editor: Original Long Mountain history rests on the FFLOS register alone. The Rhudy move and the Rhudy standing claim rest on the FFLA lists only; no Rhudy-specific page was found in two searches. The FFLA lists place the Rhudy entry under Relocated / Replica Lookouts, so the list does not say whether the structure was moved or replicated. The register describes a 1972 conversion and removal, with no mention of moving, so the relocation is unconfirmed. Access, staffing and current condition are unknown. No photos found.
